title: Batch 5 of the JA Joomla j6 slot contracts: all eleven templates carry a contract; JA Civica, JA Conference, JA Diner and JA Ego are offered after measuring every heading and text, the other seven say why not
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout, read templates/joomla-{ja-comics,ja-conf,ja-diner,ja-educatsy,ja-ego,ja-eventcamp,ja-fit}.json through loadContract: template key, ready, readyNote, minVersion, contrast, templateVars, paletteBands.
S2: Build the module sheet (joomlaSlot) for joomla-ja-eventcamp (Moxie) and joomla-ja-educatsy (MotherDuck).

S3: node packages/design/tracy-ds-slot/scripts/pass-joomla.mjs ja-conf --port 53295 --cdp 9795 --evidence <tmp> (release restored in Docker, stylesheets tokenized, Moxie, MotherDuck, Toggl Track and Apple worn, cleared, stand removed).
expect: S1: each contract's template is joomla/<slug> (left out, each re-measured and offered by round 3: JA Comics, Educatsy, Eventcamp and Fit, REG-PR-1134-ds-contracts-r3e; JA Coach and Colab, REG-PR-1134-ds-contracts-r3d; JA Civica and Company, REG-PR-1134-ds-contracts-r3a); exactly ja-conf, ja-diner and ja-ego are ready; each ready one names minVersion (conf 1.0.2, diner 1.0.1, ego 1.0.1); every readyNote names tasks/evidence/ds-contracts-batch5-2026-10-11/<slug>-j6; every contract judges heading and text contrast; Ego maps --body-headings-color to the system.

S2: Eventcamp's light T4 palette band (.t4-palette-light) takes the worn surface, its text the text colour and its links the readable accent; Educatsy's active menu link takes the readable accent with !important.
S3: verdicts 12/12, controls 0,0,0,0, no text under 4.5:1 worse than the template's own, lowest page share following >= 0.5.

selectors.contracts: packages/design/tracy-ds-slot/templates/joomla-ja-*.json ready, readyNote, minVersion, contrast.heading, contrast.text, templateVars, paletteBands, accentTextImportant

evidence: tasks/evidence/ds-contracts-batch5-2026-10-11/README.md: per-template measure (every heading and text judged), screenshots checked by eye, the four re-releases verified from their own zip.
fence: which batch-5 templates are offered and the contract fields and emitter rules that made them pass; not the six not offered (their causes are recorded, not fixed) nor the release upload (RELEASE-DS-BATCH5.sh, a person runs it)
